'''Green Squad''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military unit deployed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. Green Squad was part of [[Second Platoon]], and its members were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].
